$comment: The production origins of the website and the web app (decision D-20), and the earlier addresses that send people on to them. Code reads this file: the website's defaults (website/src/config/urls.ts), the pitch deck, the Deploy and Release workflows (the app's APP_URL, and the checks that the addresses answer and that Auth allows the e-mail links: tool/web/check_live.py, tool/web/check_auth_urls.py) and the page the old app address answers with (tool/web/package_vercel.py). Two files spell the addresses themselves and are checked against it: the Android manifest's App Link hosts (tool/android/check_manifest.py) and website/vercel.json's redirect (the website's unit tests); make docs-check C17 checks every other address in the repository. 'legacy' addresses send people on to 'origin' for good, from the repository: the website's with a redirect, the web app's with a page that first clears what the app kept in the browser there; 'aliases' redirect by the Vercel project's domain setting.
